# Rasul Shaikh - AI GTM Engineer

> AI GTM Engineer who runs go-to-market from the command line (Claude Code, Python, bash). Scopes strategy first (TAM, ICP, personas, 1P/2P/3P signal selection), then builds the end-to-end engine that executes it, unattended. $550K+ revenue closed, $3.5M+ pipeline sourced across 3 greenfield GTM builds.

Rasul Shaikh is an AI GTM Engineer based in Pune, India, working remotely worldwide (IST, overlaps US, EU, MENA, ANZ). He builds production GTM systems in Clay, n8n, Python, and Claude Code across every service line: positioning, copywriting, outbound, ABM, RevOps, and LinkedIn content.

Key results: 5 customers closed ($145K ARR) and $897K+ qualified/active pipeline in 9 months at Omnibound AI (greenfield build); 40% pipeline-efficiency gain and $180K+ ARR growth at RemoteState; lead qualification cut from 48h to 9.6h; 1.5%+ positive reply rates across 150+ domains and 300+ mailboxes at 95%+ deliverability.

Fit criteria he applies: automated outbound for TAM > 20k accounts and LTV > $5K; asset-led ABM for TAM < 20k accounts and LTV > $50K; inbound orchestration when existing traffic or brand pull exists; LinkedIn content flywheel when the ICP is active on LinkedIn.
